Map notes & sources

Tree dots represent locations, not canopy sizes. Areas and distances are map estimates, not survey measurements.

Five aerials come from NC OneMap; Fall 2022 comes from USDA NAIP via USGS. The 2022 leaf-on image was captured September 23 at 0.6 m ground resolution. Winter dates are supported by tile metadata; the 2010 acquisition date is unverified.

Historical images may have small alignment offsets.
